flagged.note: Two instructions for warfarin under different names. Coumadin is the brand name for warfarin, and warfarin sodium is the salt form of the same ingredient. Released text gives 5 mg once a day and 2.5 mg once a day, so a patient could follow both and take a double dose.

Percocet is a combination product of oxycodone and acetaminophen. The text gives Percocet 5 mg every 6 hours as needed and acetaminophen 650 mg every 4 hours, so a patient could take the acetaminophen component twice.
Zestril is a brand name of lisinopril. The released text gives two once-daily 10 mg instructions, one under each name, so a patient could follow both and take 20 mg a day. Flagged.
